# Level Moment SDK

Read [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md), then the complete integration packet in
[tools/claude-skill-levelmoment](./tools/claude-skill-levelmoment/).

Use the immutable preview release
[v0.2.0-preview.1](https://github.com/levelmomentorg/sdk/releases/tag/v0.2.0-preview.1).
It is not production-certified. The README has anonymous download links for
the paired core and platform tarballs.

Package guides:

- [Web](./sdk/web/README.md)
- [React Native](./sdk/react-native/README.md)
- [Flutter](./sdk/flutter/README.md)
- [Unity](./sdk/unity/README.md)
